snapshot: Northwind Payments launched a new invoicing product and named a new Chief Revenue Officer this month [1][2]. A report of a possible acquisition is not yet confirmed [3].

key_developments.text: Launched Northwind Invoices, a billing tool for small businesses.
Appointed Dana Okafor as Chief Revenue Officer, joining from a larger payments firm.
Reported quarterly revenue growth of 18% compared with the previous quarter.
A single blog says Northwind is in talks to be acquired. No other outlet confirms it.
A page mentions a new partnership with a regional bank, but it shows no publish date.

talking_points: Congratulate the team on the Northwind Invoices launch and ask how early customers respond.
Ask how the new CRO plans to change the sales approach for mid-size accounts.
risks: An acquisition rumour could change priorities or budgets. Treat it as unconfirmed.
A new leader may re-open existing vendor decisions.
questions: What is the timeline for rolling Northwind Invoices out beyond small businesses?
How might the leadership change affect your purchasing process?
Can you confirm or clarify the partnership with the regional bank?

sources.title: Northwind names new Chief Revenue Officer
